title: 2000 Madeiran regional election
text: The 2000 Madeira Regional Election was an election held on 15 October 2000 to elect the 61 members of the regioanl legislative assembly for the Portuguese autonomous region of the Madeira. There was an increase of two more seats in dispute, compared with the previous election, distributed by the 11 municipalities of the archipelago, proportionally to the number of registered voters of each municipality.
